ROOT.scriptdef: if exists (select name from sysobjects where name = 'POS_EksportZgody' and type = 'P') drop procedure CDN.POS_EksportZgody;

CREATE PROCEDURE [CDN].[POS_EksportZgody] @rowVersion bigint, @PointOfSaleId int AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
declare @Typ_Zgoda int = 6560, @Typ_Knt int = 32, @Typ_Osoba int = 8211 declare @GIDY TABLE(Typ int,Numer int, lp int) declare @Zgody TABLE(GUID nvarchar(41),ConsentHeaderId int,CustomerId nvarchar(41),ContactId nvarchar(41),ConsentDate datetime,WithdrawalDate datetime,WithdrawalReasonId int,IsActive nvarchar(5), Zgo_CzasModyfikacji bigint) declare @PckID INT = (select pck_picoid from cdn.PicoKonfig join cdn.picostanowiska on psa_pckid=pck_picoid where psa_id=@PointOfSaleId)
INSERT INTO @GIDY select 32,KntGidNumer,0 from cdn.POS_KntDoEksportu(@PointOfSaleId,0)
INSERT INTO @GIDY select distinct 8211,kns_kntnumer,kns_kntlp from cdn.KntOsoby join @GIDY on kns_kntnumer=Numer
INSERT INTO @Zgody select distinct zgo_GUID as [@GUID], Zgo_RodzajZgody as [@ConsentHeaderId], knt_GUID as [@CustomerGUID], kns_GUID as [@ContactPersonGUID], -- as [@AddressHeaderId] NULL -- as [@ContactId] NULL DateAdd(d,Zgo_DataUdzielenia,convert(datetime,'28-12-1800',105)) as [@ConsentDate], case when Zgo_DataWycofania=0 then null else DateAdd(d,Zgo_DataWycofania,convert(datetime,'28-12-1800',105)) end as [@WithdrawalDate], case when Zgo_PowodWycofania = 0 then null else Zgo_PowodWycofania end as [@WithdrawalReasonId], case when Zgo_DataUdzielenia <= DateDiff(d, convert(datetime,'28-12-1800',105),getdate()) and (Zgo_DataWycofania > DateDiff(d, convert(datetime,'28-12-1800',105),getdate()) OR Zgo_DataWycofania = 0) then 'true' else 'false' end as [@IsActive], Zgo_CzasModyfikacji from @GIDY join cdn.Zgody on Zgo_ObiNumer = Numer and Zgo_ObiTyp = Typ and Zgo_Obilp = lp join cdn.Slowniki on Zgo_RodzajZgody = Slw_Id left join cdn.KntKarty on Knt_GIDNumer = Numer AND Knt_GIDTyp = Typ and lp = 0 left join cdn.KntOsoby on KnS_KntNumer = Numer and 8211 = Typ and KnS_KntLp = lp where knt_GUID is not null and typ=32 or kns_GUID is not null and typ=8211 AND Zgo_CzasModyfikacji > @rowVersion
SELECT isnull((select max(Zgo_CzasModyfikacji) from @Zgody),@rowVersion) AS [@RowVersion] ,( select GUID as [@GUID], ConsentHeaderId as [@ConsentHeaderId], CustomerId as [@CustomerGUID], ContactId as [@ContactPersonGUID], ConsentDate as [@ConsentDate], WithdrawalDate as [@WithdrawalDate], WithdrawalReasonId as [@WithdrawalReasonId], IsActive as [@IsActive] from @Zgody for xml path('Consent'), type) for xml path('Consents') SET NOCOUNT OFF;
END
GRANT EXECUTE ON CDN.POS_EksportZgody TO CDNRaport
